design_condition: The large footprint is placed toward the southeastern edge, leaving a narrow green belt and retaining a calm height relationship with the low-rise surroundings.

positive.statement: The moderate height communicates well and calmly with the small, low-rise buildings nearby.
The inner courtyards and air spaces structure the volume and create an atmospheric learning environment.
The balconies and courtyards allow lessons to be extended outdoors.
The sports halls are well lit, and their visibility enriches the relationship between the building and the outside space.
The idea of a large school bringing together all age groups in a strong spatial structure is easy to understand.

negative.statement: Because of the large footprint, the surrounding green belt and existing tree line are sometimes very narrow.
The strong direction of the inner street is not understood, and the multifunctional foyer loses spaciousness through its division into sections.
The platform widths at the central staircases are sometimes very narrow.
Lighting classrooms only via an inner courtyard is not conceivable for rooms used for permanent residence.
The spatial proximity of the schools and the limited outdoor space may not meet the needs of all users.
